title: Deeply Nested Conditionals (Arrow Anti-Pattern)
pattern: Nested `if` statements wrapped inside other `if` blocks where the outer conditions only act as validations or preconditions with no corresponding `else` branches.
why_bad: Pushes context onto the reader's mental stack. Each nesting level forces the reader to carry and remember all previous preconditions.
detection: Nested `if` blocks where the parent block has no `else` statement and the inner body does not introduce new alternative execution branches.
counterexample: Nested `if` statements where each nesting level has distinct, substantive `else` branches handling alternative business logic paths.
source: Steve McConnell, *Code Complete*, Section 19.4; Martin Fowler, *Refactoring*, "Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses".
